zh-CN.title: 色盲模拟器 Pro
zh-CN.intro: 专业色觉缺陷（CVD）模拟器。支持红色盲、红色弱、绿色盲、绿色弱、蓝色盲、蓝色弱、全色盲、蓝锥单色共 8 种色觉类型的实时模拟，可对单个颜色、整组调色板或上传图片做变换；内置 WCAG 2.1 对比度检查、CIE ΔE 色差矩阵与色盲安全配色建议。全部计算在浏览器本地完成，图片不会上传到任何服务器。
note: 本工具纯前端运行，数据不会上传到服务器
建议在主流浏览器（Chrome/Safari/Firefox/Edge）中使用
模拟结果来自色彩科学模型推算，不等同于医学诊断

en-US.title: Color Blindness Simulator Pro
en-US.intro: A professional color vision deficiency (CVD) simulator. It models 8 vision types in real time — protanopia, protanomaly, deuteranopia, deuteranomaly, tritanopia, tritanomaly, achromatopsia and blue-cone monochromacy — and transforms a single color, an entire palette or an uploaded image. Includes a WCAG 2.1 contrast checker, a CIE Delta-E confusion matrix and color-blind-safe palette suggestions. Everything runs locally in your browser; images are never uploaded.
